summary: Bei Yi adapts Michael Devine’s Apache-2.0 joint certificate in Yuanda Xu’s distinct-zero counting framework. This version retains the eight detectors and the weighted simple-zero estimate. It changes two detector coefficients in one square, preserves the unknown moment coefficients and weight, and updates the finite-precision error bounds with exact rational arithmetic.
method: Two derivative-detector coefficients in the Devine–Xu joint moment certificate
